newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian stocks maintain strong run.
newsitem.headline: Estonian stocks maintain strong run.

text.p: Estonian shares were still bullish on Tuesday and dealers said they were expected to stay strong although there were signs of stabilisation.
The share index gained 1.42 percent to close at 204.82 percent on turnover of 50.6 million kroons on the official list.
Hansapank was most active after a slow start to turn over 20.7 million kroons to close 2.95 kroons up on 203.75 kroons, extending its latest price rise.
"Other stocks also are following Hansapank's run with movement in Forekespank and Union Bank and this may continue for another week, but then stocks will stabilise," said one trader.
Dealers said that Hansapank's rise was not sustainable and it was also expected to stabilise around current levels.
Forekspank was strongly traded throughout the day to finish 1.73 kroons higher on 150.25 kroons with 12.8 million kroons of shares changing hands.
Union Bank shares saw turnover of 8.1 million kroons of shares to end trading on 44.20, 1.25 kroons stronger.
Among other stocks, Savings Bank also gained to finish 1.50 kroons up at 96.85 on trade of 7.5 million kroons.
The over-the-counter market turned over 8.5 million kroons of shares.
Rakvere meat plant completely dominated trade with turnover 6.5 million kroons to close 0.15 up on 13.65 kroons.
